messages:
emma (People Ops): Quick note on this cycle— we're piloting a lightweight "shadow calibrator" flow to reduce meeting time. Read through; small asks from managers.

emma (People Ops): TL;DR: review forms due MON 11:59pm PT. Shadow calibration runs Wed (asynchronous) + Thu live panels (30m). If you're on travel/LOA, request extension by Sun EOD.

jon (People Ops): What is "shadow calibrator"? It's a designated reviewer who pre-reads docs and flags 2-3 cases for live discussion; others review asynchronously and only join the live panel if flagged. Goal: cut live time by ~60%.

rachel (Eng Dir): Curious  how are shadow calibrators chosen? Want to make sure we don't silo perspectives.

jon (People Ops): We'll pick shadow calibrators based on cross-team exposure and past calibration experience. Managers can also opt into a peer-shadow model (i.e., swap shadows with another manager) if helpful.

tony (Eng Manager): For partial-cycle hires, do we still submit full evidence? We have several mid-quarter contractors.

emma (People Ops): For <6 weeks tenure, mark "insufficient cycle data" in the rating field and add onboarding milestones + start date in manager_notes. For 6-12 weeks, include 1-2 evidence bullets and mark "early-stage".

priya (IC): Can we edit self-assessments after manager submits? Had a bad typo last time.

jon (People Ops): Yes, edits allowed until the form deadline. After that all fields lock until post-calibration. If you need a late change, ping this thread with a screenshot and reason.

emma (People Ops): New: please include a one-line "context" header at top of manager_notes: e.g., "Role: Backend Eng 2 | Major project: sharded cache | FTE: 100%". Helps shadow calibrators triage quickly.

jon (People Ops): CSV import note: header must be exactly `employee_email,manager_notes,share_with_ic`. share_with_ic expects `yes` or `no`. Wrong headers cause import failure.

rachel (Eng Dir): Can we batch simple meets-expects cases? We have a cluster of obvious meets/no flags.

emma (People Ops): Yes, tag rows as `batch:quick` in the sheet and attach one representative example doc. Shadow calibrators will fast-pass batches unless a reviewer flags it.

tony (Eng Manager): How many shadow flags can a shadow raise? We want to avoid over-flagging.

jon (People Ops): Limit is 4 flags per shadow per session; if you hit the cap, add the extra to the "needs discussion" column and we'll triage additional reviewers.

priya (IC): Timing: when do ICs see manager feedback? It felt weird to see changes after calibration last cycle.

emma (People Ops): Default: manager feedback is shared post-calibration. Managers can tick `share-draft` on the form to let ICs see manager notes earlier, but note that calibration outcomes can change.

jon (People Ops): Small template for manager_notes (pasteable):
```
Context: role, FTE, main project
Evidence: 2 bullets (outcome + metric/impact)
Suggested outcome: rating + short rationale
Development: 1 line
```

emma (People Ops): Overflow policy: if your team > 25 reports, you get 1 floater reviewer automatically. Add a comment in the sheet if you also need time-zone-specific coverage.

review-bot: Reminder scheduled: Review forms due in 48 hours. Forms link: https://app.redwood/reviews

rachel (Eng Dir): Sounds good. We'll volunteer one shadow across our org and try the batch flow.

tony (Eng Manager): Thanks  will use the template and tag quick-pass rows.

priya (IC): Appreciated  template makes edits faster.

emma (People Ops): If anything breaks with the import or you need an unlock after the deadline, ping @jon or me here. We'll post the short 1-pager and the shadow-calibrator FAQ in #review-ops by tomorrow.

jon (People Ops): Reminder  attachments >4MB -> upload to Drive and paste link in manager_notes to avoid timeout. Filenames: `review-<last>-<first>.pdf` preferred."
